title: Qa Engineer
description:
Job Title: QA Engineer
 Experience: 2-6 years
 Location: Indore, M.P.- Full-time, in-office only 5 days in a week  
 Role: Full-time About the Role: 
We are seeking a skilled QA Engineer responsible for designing and executing manual tests to ensure the functionality and reliability of web and mobile applications. The QA Engineer will collaborate closely with development and cross-functional teams to maintain high-quality software throughout the development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities: Review and analyze system specifications and requirements. Design, create, and execute test cases. Perform API testing and mobile application testing. Ensure comprehensive functional testing coverage. Evaluate product code against specifications to identify defects. Document testing phases, results, and defects through detailed logs. Report bugs and collaborate with development teams for resolution. Assist in troubleshooting and post-release/post-implementation testing. Collaborate with testing and development teams to ensure product quality. Write and maintain testing documentation, including test plans, procedures, and test cases. Requirements: Proven experience as a QA Engineer or similar role. Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, project management, and Agile frameworks. Experience with regression testing. Proficiency in API testing and mobile testing. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively. Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent. Minimum of  2+ years of experience working as a QA Engineer within a Scrum/Agile environment.

Key Skills: Manual testing,Manual,QA testing,DBMS,Software testing,API Testing,Quality assurance,Quality assurance engineering
